name: Mission Valley
demographics: Westfield Mission Valley serves a diverse San Diego trade area with a strong mix of young professionals, families, and college-aged visitors given its proximity to San Diego State University and multiple residential neighborhoods. The center attracts middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes ranging from $65,000-$95,000, appealing to value-conscious shoppers seeking mainstream retail brands and family-friendly dining and entertainment options. Typical visitors include millennials and Gen X families who favor convenient outdoor shopping experiences with a blend of fashion, food, and entertainment activities.
description: Westfield Mission Valley is a spacious outdoor mall undergoing a reimagined transformation into a destination for art, food, and culture with fresh design and curated shops. The center features diverse retail stores, restaurants, an AMC movie theater, and engaging entertainment experiences including Sandbox VR.
summary: Westfield Mission Valley is a regional shopping destination in San Diego that combines retail, dining, and entertainment in an open-air format. Operating under Centennial Real Estate Management, the center is currently undergoing redevelopment to enhance its offerings with curated experiences and modern amenities.
